utility.value: Lompoc Utilities (Electric Division, City of Lompoc)
utility.notes: Lompoc has operated its own municipal electric utility since 1923 (originally Lompoc Light & Power), confirmed via the city's own Electric Division page and its membership in the Northern California Power Agency (NCPA). This is a municipal utility, not PG&E or SCE, independently confirmed rather than assumed from county location.

value.name: Lompoc Utilities (Electric Division, City of Lompoc)
value.notes: Lompoc is not named among Central Coast Community Energy (3CE)'s member communities on 3CE's own official site. As a municipal utility (operating since 1923, NCPA member), Lompoc does not participate in a CCA the way IOU-served cities do — the city's own municipal utility is both the distribution and generation provider.
